params.name: Delimiter
params.reason: Groups matching keys under CommonPrefixes in the response.

params.name: KeyMarker
params.reason: Sets the key position to resume listing from.

params.name: MaxKeys
params.reason: Limits the number of keys returned.

params.name: OptionalObjectAttributes
params.reason: Selects additional fields returned for objects.

params.name: Prefix
params.reason: Returns only keys beginning with the specified prefix.

params.name: VersionIdMarker
params.reason: Sets the version position to resume listing from.

reason: The documentation identifies the prefix as a selection criterion, the markers and maximum as listing controls, and the remaining parameters as response formatting or shaping.
